record.paper_title: Open Problems in Constructive Function Theory
record.original_question: Is there any family of orthogonal polynomials, beyond the currently known special cases, for which the entropy E_n admits a compact closed-form expression?

evidence.quote: QUESTION 5.2. Is there any other family of polynomials for which E_n has a compact closed expression?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\{p_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ be a system of polynomials orthonormal on a (possibly infinite) interval $I\subseteq\mathbb{R}$ with respect to a positive weight $w(x)$, so that
$$\int_I p_n(x)p_m(x)\,w(x)\,dx=\delta_{nm}.$$
Define the (Boltzmann–Shannon) information entropy of $p_n$ by
$$E_n \;=\; -\int_I p_n(x)^2\,\log\!\bigl(p_n(x)^2\bigr)\,w(x)\,dx.$$
For a handful of classical families (such as the Chebyshev polynomials of the first and second kind) the quantity $E_n$ is known to admit a compact closed-form expression as an explicit elementary function of $n$.

Problem. Exhibit a family of orthogonal polynomials, other than the presently known special cases, for which the entropy $E_n$ admits a compact closed-form expression valid for all $n\ge 0$; or prove that no such additional family exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature provides asymptotic formulas, recurrence-based numerical methods, and analytic expressions of Fisher/Rényi/Shannon entropies in terms of polynomial parameters for classical families (Hermite, Laguerre, Gegenbauer, Chebyshev), but no new family beyond the known special cases is reported to yield a compact closed form for E_n. The question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Computation of the Entropy of Polynomials Orthogonal on an Interval
status_evidence.snippet: An effective method for computing the entropy uses only the recurrence coefficients; closed forms are not generally available.
status_evidence.claim: For general families only numerical/asymptotic methods, not closed forms, are available.

status_evidence.title: Discrete Entropies of Chebyshev Polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Entropy computed exactly for Chebyshev polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Closed-form expressions are known mainly for Chebyshev-type families.

status_evidence.title: Information Entropy of Classical Orthogonal Polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Entropy analyzed for Hermite, Laguerre, Gegenbauer via asymptotics.
status_evidence.claim: For other classical families only asymptotic or parametric expressions exist.
